title: Bankdata builds bespoke systems for the banks that own it
content:
Bankdata is a member-owned Danish cooperative that builds bespoke systems for the banks that own it. Bespoke build would normally be a qualifying signal — no product of its own to protect — but here it is an in-house service to the owners rather than an offer made in a market.

The consequence is that Bankdata cannot function as a channel. It does not sell delivery to third parties, so there is no route through it to other buyers; any engagement would be with the owner-banks' own systems, which makes it a direct-adoption target and a slow one. Its stack was not researched, and it sits at priority 4 behind an open-source screen.
